cases.code:
def cap(f):
    try:
        v = f()
        return v if v is not None else 'ok'
    except Exception as e:
        return type(e).__name__

kv = sol.VersionedKV()
kv.set("a", 1); kv.set("b", 2)
r = [kv.commit()]
kv.delete("a"); kv.set("b", 20)
r.append(kv.commit())
r.append(kv.get_at("a", 1))
r.append(cap(lambda: kv.get_at("a", 2)))
kv.rollback(1)
r.append(kv.get("a"))
kv.set("c", 3)
r.append(kv.commit())
r.append(kv.get_at("b", 2))
kv.rollback(0)
r += [kv.has("a"), kv.has("c"), kv.latest()]
result = r

    try:
        v = f()
        return v if v is not None else 'ok'
    except Exception as e:
        return type(e).__name__

kv = sol.VersionedKV()
r = [cap(lambda: kv.get("x")), cap(lambda: kv.delete("x")), kv.has("x"), kv.latest()]
kv.set("x", 5)
r += [kv.get("x"), kv.has("x")]
kv.delete("x")
r += [kv.has("x"), cap(lambda: kv.get("x")), cap(lambda: kv.delete("x"))]
kv.set("x", None)
r += [kv.has("x"), kv.get("x")]

cases.name: v4:rollback_preserves_history
cases.code:
def cap(f):
    try:
        v = f()
        return v if v is not None else 'ok'
    except Exception as e:
        return type(e).__name__

kv = sol.VersionedKV()
kv.set("a", 1); kv.commit()
kv.set("a", 2); kv.commit()
kv.rollback(1)
r = [kv.get("a"), kv.latest()]
kv.set("c", 9)
r.append(kv.commit())
r += [kv.get_at("a", 1), kv.get_at("a", 2), kv.get_at("a", 3),
      kv.has("c"), cap(lambda: kv.get_at("c", 2)), kv.get_at("c", 3), kv.latest()]
result = r
